facts.fact: An undersecretary of South Sudan's Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services told a workshop in Juba that the Cybercrimes and Computer Misuse Act, 2026 is now law.

SSD.note: The ministry says only that it remains committed to developing a data governance policy; no drafting is stated.

facts.fact: The ministry's undersecretary said a Data Protection Bill is in preparation, and the deputy minister urged the legislature to speed its passage.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services

SSD.note: The document states nothing on control or hosting of state data.
Only an aim to connect every state and county by December is stated; no connection of local government offices is reported.
No local research institution is named as researching digital policy.

facts.fact: A ministry-hosted workshop in Juba, 8-10 September 2026, with about 50 participants including civil society groups, telecom operators and regulators, covered preparation for the Data Protection Bill.
facts.system: Data Governance Capacity Building and Engagement Workshop
